caption: The drawing features the silhouette of a horse in mid-leap, with its legs extended both forward and backward as if jumping or galloping. The horse is depicted in a flat, grayish-black tone with subtle variations in shading that suggest some texture or grain, particularly visible on its body and legs. The outline of the horse is bold and dark, clearly separating it from the plain, light beige background. The horse's mane and tail are simplified, and facial features are minimal, with only the contour of the head, ear, and eye indicated. The composition is centered, with the horse's form dominating the image and positioned horizontally across the page. In the lower left portion of the drawing, there is small, finely printed text reading "J. ROTHENBERG."
title: Horse Weather Vane
